app.name: EDB Circulars Assistant
app.tagline: Automatically collect circulars and documents, then answer with grounded RAG

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage the circular library and Q&A service
login.heroLead: Bring scattered EDB circulars, attachments and programme documents into one place, and find the source with a single question.
login.pointCollectDesc: Scheduled crawls of the EDB circular system and related sites, with new files indexed automatically
login.pointAskDesc: Every answer cites the circular number and links to the original document
login.pointBilingualDesc: Dates shown as yyyy-mm-dd in Hong Kong time

documents.title: Circulars & Documents
documents.subtitle: Search first, then narrow by programme and topic
documents.empty: Go to Ingest Status and press “Crawl now” — the system will collect and index circulars automatically.
documents.emptySearchHint: Try a circular number (e.g. EDBCM048/2026), a shorter keyword, or clear the filters.
documents.loadError: Could not load the document list. Check your network and retry.
documents.detailLoadError: Could not load document details. Check your network and retry.
documents.previewFailed: Could not render this PDF. Try Download instead.

chat.title: Ask about EDB materials
chat.subtitle: Answers are grounded in your circular library and always cite their sources
chat.placeholder: Ask a question about a circular…
chat.emptyLead: Ask directly, or start from one of the examples below. Use “Search scope” to narrow to a programme or topic.
chat.prompt1: What can the Sister School Scheme grant be spent on?
chat.prompt2: What are the LWLSSG reporting requirements for 2026/27?
chat.prompt3: Which recent circulars are about curriculum updates?
chat.prompt4: Summarise the key points of EDBCM048/2026.
chat.groundingNote: Answers are generated only from collected circulars and documents; if nothing relevant exists, the assistant will say so.
chat.noCitations: No matching circular was retrieved. Try a circular number (e.g. EDBCM048/2026) or more specific keywords.
chat.timeout: The reply took too long. Please try again, or use a shorter question / circular number.
chat.error: Could not reach the chat service. Check that the API is running.

status.title: Ingest Status
status.subtitle: Run crawls, watch live progress, and re-index when embeddings change
status.crawlError: Could not start crawl. Try again.
status.failedTypeHint: Most failures are Word/Excel (.docx/.xlsx) files — indexing currently supports PDF text only.
status.stopping: Stopping… will finish the current file
status.reindexError: Could not start re-index. Try again.
status.reindexBusy: A crawl or re-index is already running.
status.classifyError: Could not start classification. Try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure crawl sources, LLM, and answer behaviour
settings.saveCount: Save {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
settings.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
settings.secretKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current value
settings.dimConfirm: Changing embedding dimension requires re-indexing. Continue?
settings.reindexWarning: Re-index required after embedding dimension change
settings.readonlyHint: Change these via environment variables / .env and restart.
settings.buildTimeHint: NEXT_PUBLIC_* variables are baked in at web build time; update .env and rebuild to apply.
settings.groupSourcesDesc: Manage the sites and circular systems to crawl. Changes are written to sources.yaml.
settings.groupChatDesc: Control answer style, citations and how many passages are retrieved per question.
settings.groupConnectDesc: Language model, embedding and optional Dify service credentials.
settings.groupSystemDesc: Crawl behaviour, file storage and OAuth settings.
settings.sourcesHint: Toggles take effect on the next crawl; press “Save sources” to write sources.yaml. New sources are disabled by default.
settings.sourcesAddHint: Enter the URL and crawl rules; new sources start disabled.
settings.sourcesEnabledHint: Crawled automatically on schedule when enabled
settings.sourcesEmptyHint: Add a site or circular system, or use AI suggestions to get started quickly.
settings.sourcesPriorityHint: 0 is highest; lower numbers crawl first
settings.sourcesAiHint: Enter a topic or URL and the assistant will suggest public sources to add.
settings.sourcesSuggestError: Could not get suggestions. Check that a Jina API key is set.
settings.sourcesSuggestFailed: Suggestion search did not finish. Try again.

help.temperature: 0 is most conservative, 1 most creative; 0.1–0.3 recommended for Q&A
help.max_tokens: Maximum length of a single answer
help.system_prompt: Instructions read before every answer; sets tone and rules
help.cite_inline_refs: Add [1] [2] markers inside answers so claims can be checked against sources
help.local_top_k: Passages retrieved from the local library per question
help.dify_top_k: Passages retrieved from Dify per question
help.jina_embedding_dim: Changing this requires re-indexing all documents
help.dify_enabled: When on, the Dify knowledge base can be selected in Chat
help.crawl_enabled: When off, scheduled crawls pause; manual crawls still work
help.crawl_rate_limit_seconds: Minimum gap between requests so source sites are not overloaded
help.storage_backend: local uses the server disk; minio requires a running MinIO service
help.llm_provider: openrouter is the default; ollama requires a local model
